Debugging and safety configuration contexts

Source: R/config_flags.R
config_contexts.Rd

Ports of the configuration context managers of jax: each evaluates code with the option set and restores the previous value.

Usage

debug_nans(new_val = TRUE, code)

debug_infs(new_val = TRUE, code)

numpy_dtype_promotion(new_val = TRUE, code)

log_compiles(new_val = TRUE, code)

explain_cache_misses(new_val = TRUE, code)

check_tracer_leaks(new_val = TRUE, code)

checking_leaks(code)

no_tracing(code)

no_execution(code)

transfer_guard_host_to_device(new_val = TRUE, code)

transfer_guard_device_to_host(new_val = TRUE, code)

transfer_guard_device_to_device(new_val = TRUE, code)

transfer_guard(new_val, code)

Arguments

new_val

New value of the option.

code

Expression evaluated with the option set.

Details

  • debug_nans() / debug_infs(): raise an error (class jax_floating_point_error) when a primitive or a jitted computation produces NaN / infinite values.

  • numpy_dtype_promotion("strict"): forbid implicit promotion between different strongly typed dtypes.

  • log_compiles(): report every XLA compilation.

  • explain_cache_misses(): report why jit traces again.

  • check_tracer_leaks(): leaked tracers raise errors (jaxR always detects use of a dead tracer).

  • no_tracing() / no_execution(): raise an error on any jit tracing / execution.

  • transfer_guard() and its directional variants: "allow", "log", "disallow", "log_explicit" or "disallow_explicit" for implicit (conversions of R data that is not a scalar, as.array(), printing) and explicit (device_put(), device_get()) transfers.
